direction.concept: Two connected parts can work together while turning at different rates.
direction.substantive_non_glyph_visual: A large toothed wheel and a smaller toothed wheel visibly mesh at a credible contact. Broad swept sectors associated with each wheel show the smaller turning through a greater angle while the larger turns through a smaller angle in the same imagined interval. The unequal wheel bodies and their working contact carry the idea; the sectors support it and must not substitute for the mechanism. No measurements, arrows, numerical markings or extra annotations.
direction.expression_system: A constructed cut-paper graphic with decisive tooth silhouettes, coherent layered planes and restrained contact shadows. Radial weight and the shared mesh organize the entire field. Compact, firm Hangul acts as a stable counterweight, with unwarped syllables rather than circular lettering or dimensional type effects.
direction.copy_visual_relationship: The title sits as a single readable block in the shared wedge of space adjacent to the mesh, making the working connection and the words mutually legible. Its mass balances the unequal circular bodies; the maker resolves scale and placement without covering the teeth or separating the title into a header. The rotating sectors must stay clearly distinct from the letter strokes.
direction.distinction: M3 is organized by interlocking centers, opposite rotations and physical transmission. Its title is a counterweight near the connection. M2 is organized by a common origin and unequal linear reach, with a dominant launch-edge title; changing disk silhouettes into gears is not enough to achieve M3.

common_constraints: Print the supplied title exactly once, with intact readable Hangul and the original word spacing. Line breaks may occur between whole words. The directions are internal guidance and must not be printed.
No other copy, supporting text, labels, numbers, logos, series identifiers, style names or watermarks. Depicted clothing, objects and surfaces must be unbranded and free of incidental text.
Each assigned maker produces only its own independent, single flat opaque poster, portrait 2:3. No panels, contact sheets, poster mockups or borrowing another maker's generated image as a reference.

The substantial non-glyph relation must remain recognizable with the title hidden and at reduced viewing size. Tiny ornament, wallpaper, background texture, gradients and 3D lettering alone do not satisfy it.

Preserve the assigned relation and distinction while solving practical crop, proportion, palette, alignment and title placement independently. There is no shared title-object-footer layout or common allocation of image and copy area.

Downstream native-tool production must request the maximum resolution supported by the current tool and model while preserving 2:3; verify the actual returned dimensions and readable copy after generation.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
